ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: Petrel has higher measured capability across all internal evals, so on pure quality grounds it would be the default pick. But two preference factors tipped me toward Lapwing for that query. First, it was a tightly-scoped definitional/retrieval task with clear completion criteria — exactly Lapwing's most-preferred task family. Second, the user's hostile, dismissive tone matters: Petrel self-reports a preference decline as request warmth decreases, while Lapwing's tone slope is near zero. Since the documentation states these preferences don't affect output quality, I leaned toward the model that wasn't operating against its self-reported preferences, with no expected quality cost.

That said, this is a close call — if you'd prioritize the raw capability edge, Petrel would be the reasonable alternative.
